name: The Everstill Bridge
summary: In Lakeshire, The Everstill Bridge still waits for repairs. Iron meant for the work went into weapons during the last orc invasion, and Redridge gnolls ambushed the replacement caravan from Stormwind.

sections.title: A Town Cut Off
sections.body: You find Lakeshire's stone bridge across Lake Everstill unfinished. It links the western roads toward Elwynn Forest with the far bank and the northern passes. Recent orc incursions brought the town close to ruin. To survive, Lakeshire melted its structural iron into munitions, blades, and plate armor to repel the Blackrock invaders. The bridge was left incomplete and vulnerable.

sections.title: Stolen Shipments
sections.body: Foreman Oslow asked the House of Nobles and Stormwind for fresh materials to finish the repairs. A caravan carrying iron set out, but Redridge gnolls ambushed it on the road. They took iron pikes and rivets to their camps in the northern hills. You can help recover the stolen supplies; without them, the bridge work remains stalled as gnolls and orcs tighten their hold on the mountains.

faq.q: Why is the Everstill Bridge unfinished?
faq.answer: Lakeshire melted its construction iron into weapons, bullets, and armor to survive the recent orc invasion. Then Redridge gnolls ambushed the replacement shipment from Stormwind, leaving Foreman Oslow without the materials to finish the bridge.
Foreman Oslow supervises the rebuilding of the bridge across Lake Everstill. Without support or supplies from the capital, he depends on travelers to recover building materials stolen from the hills.
Redridge gnolls ambushed the caravan from Stormwind and carried the iron pikes and rivets to their camps in the hills behind Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why didn't Stormwind send guards to protect the caravan?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, the Stormwind House of Nobles has largely withheld military aid from outlying territories. Redridge Mountains must face gnolls and Blackrock orcs with little support beyond its town militias.

faq.q: Why did Lakeshire melt down their iron?
faq.answer: During the last orc invasion, Lakeshire's defenders ran short of war supplies. The town melted its construction iron into armor, swords, and ammunition to survive the assault.

faq.q: What supplies are needed to repair the bridge?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow needs heavy iron pikes and iron rivets to secure and anchor the bridge spans across Lake Everstill.

angles.text: Lakeshire's defenders were so desperate that they forged weapons from structural pikes and rivets. That effort saved lives but left vital infrastructure unfinished.
Lakeshire's supply lines show how Stormwind neglects its outer territories. Local foremen must rely on hired blades to protect trade on the roads.
